assay: Total RNA-seq (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA, Ribo-Zero Gold), 75-bp PE, soleus muscle (S4.9.p1, S2.1.p1)
sample_inclusion: 12-week-old male and female WT (Dnmt3a flox/flox) and mD3AKO mice; RNA-seq on 'rest' (sham treadmill) and 60 min after a 30-min treadmill bout only (S4.3.p1); n = 5-7 per genotype x exercise group (FIG2)
primary_estimand: Main effect of acute exercise (60 min after 30-min treadmill run vs rest) on soleus gene expression, pooled over genotype and sex (S2.2.p2, S4.17.p1)
planned_contrasts: exercise main effect: 60 min post vs rest (S2.2.p2; paper: 1615 DEGs, FDR 5%)
genotype main effect: mD3AKO vs WT (S2.2.p2, S2.6.p1; paper: 56 DEGs, 43 up / 13 down)
genotype x exercise interaction (S2.2.p2; paper: 0 DEGs)
repeated_measure_unit: none (one soleus per mouse; independent animals)
normalization: not_reported in this article ('processed as previously described [34]', S4.11.p1); expression threshold leaves 17389 genes (S4.9.p1), rule not stated
paper_method: Differential expression for a main effect of genotype, a main effect of exercise and a genotype/exercise interaction (S4.17.p1); software and model details deferred to ref [34] (S4.11.p1), not reported here. Sex handling in the RNA-seq model not reported.
